sentences.japanese: 靴が小さすぎるから新しいのを買う必要があるな。
sentences.english: My shoes are too small. I need new ones.

sentences.japanese: 君は靴を脱ぐには及ばない。
sentences.english: You need not take off your shoes.

sentences.japanese: 靴は脱がなくていいよ！
sentences.english: You need not take off your shoes.

sentences.japanese: 君はそんな靴が流行していると思っているかもしれないが、そうじゃないんだ。
sentences.english: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.

sentences.japanese: 君の靴はその服と合わない。
sentences.english: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
